evidence: Workbook Quality Checks!C17:D17 and Internal Quality Checks row 17 require inputs and ask without the completed deliverable; the frozen skill reference adds an empty /app and no starter/schema/partial UI or reproduced rubric. The entire environment tree contains exactly Dockerfile, instructions/integration.md, instructions/hireops_rules.md, and assets/seed_data.json, with no hidden extra file. task/environment/Dockerfile:14-23 copies only instructions and assets and initializes /app with .gitkeep; its bytes equal the frozen template Dockerfile. The notes contain the public domain/runtime contract, not implementation source or a database schema. hireops_rules.md:53-55 and 434-435 explicitly leave routes, field names, UI and request schema to the builder. seed_data.json:2-25 supplies roster/constants/reference time, and the rest is input history; it is not a finished app. A normalized longest-contiguous-word comparison of all criterion descriptions against both injected notes found no overlap of 16 or more words. Actual isolated command: docker run --rm --network none --read-only --entrypoint sh sha256:ebdf6741fc24b580831365e3b3f1501571257715089d56f3213861da7ae23375 -c [find /app -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1; git -C /app ls-tree -r --name-only HEAD; existence checks /solution and /tests; sha256sum of all /instructions and /assets files]. Exit 0: /app contains only .gitkeep and .git; the sole tracked file is .gitkeep; /solution and /tests are absent. The three runtime file hashes equal the frozen sources: seed 1b39015461a7a4f23b835aeea9584caffd0266c64d394778376cbd6c8a18bcf7, rules 3524e05b02f6c854699b698f298932240e14912775149b620a7ec257622cb79d, integration 1adabb9e2d76cee5ff91b15b24f109e4f37047050da5c7b7a1274c6938a0aa66. Verified indexed build-agent.log SHA256 61b77fae36fcbd165112ee50b756c7c5036204466f2020930a24b8db0e7eb168 and artifact-binding.json SHA256 22e8e05333a99e1b01b771789bf0c64dcb10e2cb539bd815270d02811ddcd6db. Counterexample considered: a builder that merely copies a supplied server.js/UI or recovers a golden app from Git cannot do so here; neither source nor such history is supplied. A seed-rendering static mock still needs application work and cannot acquire transaction behavior from the input data; no app-score claim is made. Conforming alternative considered: an independently designed schema/routes/UI with an initially empty operational desk remains possible because the seed history is optional (hireops_rules.md:91-95), and no starter implementation fixes these choices. No required measurement is missing for this row; configured grading and provider scores are outside this finding.
